# Tube & Berger

> Tube & Berger are a German DJ and producer duo (Arndt Roerig and Marko Vidovic) from Solingen. They run the labels Kittball Records and ZEHN Records. This is their official website.

## Facts

- Members: Arndt Roerig, Marko Vidovic
- Origin: Solingen, Germany
- Genres: house, deep house, tech house, techno
- Labels: Kittball Records, ZEHN Records (own labels); releases also on FFRR, Musical Freedom, Spinnin', Toolroom, Get Physical, Universal, Virgin Records
- Albums: Introlution (2012, Kittball Records), We Are All Stars (2017)
- Known tracks: Straight Ahead (2004, with Chrissie Hynde), Imprint of Pleasure, Come On Now (Set It Off) with Juliet Sikora, Surfin, Escape from Berlin, Ruckus feat. Richard Judge, All I Want feat. Goatchy
- "E Samba 2018" by Junior Jack & Tube & Berger (Kittball Records) plays on The Vault Radio in Grand Theft Auto VI
- Stages: Tomorrowland, Parookaville, Pacha, Ushuaia, Hï Ibiza, Green Valley Brazil, ADE
